name: Midjourney
tagline: The AI image generator best known for painterly, artistic output and a devoted creative community.
tldr: Midjourney is a subscription-only text-to-image (and now video) generator, historically accessed via Discord and now also through its own web app, known for a distinctive, artistic rendering style.
Best for artists, designers, and creatives who want stylized, painterly imagery rather than strict photorealism or literal prompt-following.
Runs entirely on paid GPU-hour subscriptions (Basic through Mega) with no free tier since March 2023, and Relax/Stealth modes gated behind higher tiers.
Widely praised for image quality and style variety, but its Trustpilot reputation is notably poor, driven by billing, refund, and server-overload complaints.
Faces growing competition from newer models (e.g. Flux) that some reviewers say now rival or exceed it on realism, even as Midjourney keeps its stylistic edge.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 3.3 fast GPU hours/month; SD video only, no Relax mode

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 15 fast GPU hours/month; unlimited Relax mode images, SD & HD video, no Stealth Mode

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 30 fast GPU hours/month; Stealth Mode (private generations), unlimited SD video via Relax

plans.name: Mega
plans.notes: 60 fast GPU hours/month; maximum concurrency for high-volume production teams

pros: Distinctive, artistic rendering style that many creatives prefer over more literal/photoreal competitors
Wide range of supported styles and strong prompt-to-concept quality for creative exploration
Active, long-running creative community built around the tool
Stealth Mode (Pro/Mega) allows private generations for commercial or client work
cons: No free tier at all, unlike most competitors, so there's no way to try it without paying
Trustpilot rating sits around 1.5/5, with frequent complaints about refunds, billing, and being unable to generate during server overload
Fast GPU hours expire monthly and don't roll over, which can feel punishing for lighter users
Newer models like Flux are increasingly cited as catching up on realism, narrowing Midjourney's differentiation

sentiment.quote: Midjourney is an amazing program that helps me create realistic images as a graphic designer.
You're paying for an expensive monthly subscription – but for what? For not being able to generate any images because the system is completely overloaded.
They did not write me any comments to express their intention.

bestFor: Artists and designers who want a distinctive, painterly aesthetic
Creative teams exploring concept art, mood boards, or stylized illustration
Users who want an established community and prompt-sharing culture
Freelancers/agencies needing private (Stealth Mode) generations for client work
hotTake: Midjourney still has no free tier and a 1.5-star Trustpilot rating driven by refund complaints, yet it remains a default reference point for AI art quality.
